# 🧰 Documentation Templates

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [ADR](adr-template.md) | Record architecture and product decisions |
| [Change proposal](change-proposal-template.md) | Scope a feature or refactor |
| [Test report](test-report-template.md) | Record checks and evidence |
| [Content approval](content-approval-template.md) | Verify business details and usage rights |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Prepare a static site publication |

Copy the relevant template for each record. Replace prompts with project-specific evidence.
